_doc: AIE worker classes. A class is a body mask (SV_BODY_MASK): bit i enables dispatcher opcode i (0 CONV, 1 GEMM, 2 STENCIL, 3 LUT, 4 PERMUTE, 5 SEGOPS, 6 TAPMOD, 7 HEAD). A set lists the class of each worker in PLIO order. 'uniform' needs the whole dispatcher to fit one tile's 16 KB program memory; if the AIE compiler reports a program-memory overflow, use 'split3' (or add a finer set). Every opcode must be covered by at least one worker of the set.
